notes.title: A Tropical Breeze Just Blew In! | New Southeast Asian Plants Update 🌺🌿
notes.notes:
Hey there, plant lovers!



We’re back with another fresh and free update to grow your Urban Jungle even more lush and vibrant.



To celebrate the Southeast Asian Games Showcase – Summer Game Fest Edition, we’re adding 6 beautiful new plants endemic to Southeast Asia. Bring the spirit of endless summer into your home and turn your space into a tropical paradise!



New Plants Blooming in Your Diary:



🌸 Plumeria

🌺 Hibiscus

🌼 Papilionanthe Miss Joaquim

🌿 Madagascar Jasmine

🌷 Medinilla Magnifica

💜 Curcuma Alismatifolia



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44817681/9684b9d03a8b3e8c9dbc63b6ebb85059cc7e089d.gif"]



It’s the perfect excuse to rearrange your jungle and add some tropical flair! Stay cozy, stay green – and we’ll see you soon with even more leafy surprises. 💚



Love you all 💚, 

Maria, Kiunnei and Kirill



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44817681/2b87331300f913b55581e49d1b4116abbbfc4edd.png"]

notes.title: Urban Jungle Update: Veggie Edition is Here! 🎃🍅
notes.notes:
Hey green thumbs!

We've just teased the update last week, and now we’re here with this fresh free update to make your urban oasis even more delicious—uh, we mean lush! 😄

Introducing VEGGIES! That’s right, your plant diary just got a healthy twist with six all-new veggie plants ready to join your growing collection:

Tomato, Pepper, Cucumber, Pumpkin, Zucchini, and Cabbage 🌶️🥬🎃

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44817681/0a50720252fb5016cda8efab8f857ac0af461725.gif

But that’s not all:

🪴 13 Brand-New Pots – Because veggies need stylish homes, too!
🛠️ Optimization Fixes – Including a memory leak fix for a smoother experience
🐞 Bug Fixes – Lots of little improvements to keep your jungle cozy and carefree

Fire up your game and get planting—we can’t wait to see your vegetable patches bloom! 💚

Love you all 💚, 
Maria, Kiunnei and Kirill

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44817681/2b87331300f913b55581e49d1b4116abbbfc4edd.png

notes.title: A Tiny Patch & A Well-Deserved Tea Break ☕🌿
notes.notes:
Hey plant pals! 🌱

We just pushed a small patch to keep your cozy havens running smooth and serene. Here’s what’s been added:

🌼 A new backup system for your save files
🌼 Save files are now tidier and more optimized
🌼 We trimmed the overall game size
🌼 General optimization improvements for an even smoother experience

Since launch, we’ve been pouring our hearts into making Urban Jungle the comfiest green space it can be. Now, we’re taking a tiny break to rest our watering cans, sip some warm tea, and recharge. 💚

But don’t worry! We’ll be back soon with fresh new ideas and exciting content to make your planty adventures even more lush!

Thanks for all your support, and remember to take a moment to breathe, relax, and enjoy the little things—just like in Urban Jungle. 🌿

With love,💚, 
Maria, Kiunnei and Kirill

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44817681/2b87331300f913b55581e49d1b4116abbbfc4edd.png

notes.title: A Fresh Update for Your Green Haven!
notes.notes:
Hey cozy gardeners! 

We’ve been busy tending to Urban Jungle, and a fresh update has just sprouted!🌱✨

Here's the full changelog:

 Fixed the "Completionist" achievement
 Fixed a bug causing a dark line on the screen
 Fixed a music bug in Chapter 1
 Fixed camera movement
 Fixed UI in Creative Mode
 Added new items to Creative Mode for Chapters 7, 8, 9, and 10
 Added a "Resume" button to the Main Menu
 Reworked and updated Japanese localization
 Improved game optimization

We've made a big step forward with game optimizations, so hopefully, everything runs as smoothly as a well-watered Monstera now.💧

As always, thank you for your support! Your cozy little worlds make Urban Jungle what it is! 🌿🏡✨

Love you all 💚, 
Maria, Kiunnei and Kirill

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44817681/2b87331300f913b55581e49d1b4116abbbfc4edd.png

notes.title: A Little Breather & Our First Patch! 🌿✨
notes.notes:
Hi Friends!

It’s been a few days since Urban Jungle bloomed into the world. And wow ... it's been a one-of-a-kind ride so far! We took a moment to breathe, celebrate, and soak in all your amazing feedback (seriously, you’re the best 😻). But, of course, we couldn’t sit still for long!

We’ve already wrapped up work on the very first patch. We've been busy with tweaking, fixing, and making everything run even smoother!

And here is the changelog:

 All Begonia types now appear in Chapter 11 as intended.
 The number of Ficus types in the diary was corrected from 6 to 5.
 The "Plant Person" achievement is now obtainable.
 Rufus has been rescued from the trap under the bench in Chapter 2.
 Plant models have been optimized for better performance.
 Added Orchid, Poinsettia, and Spider Plant to Creative Mode.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44817681/660676821265d9699ab6699a622c016e53a504cd.png
Stay tuned for more updates soon, and in the meantime—keep growing those green havens! 💚

Love you all 💚, 
Maria, Kiunnei and Kirill

notes.title: Dev Update - New Level, Diary & Demo
notes.notes:
Hiiiii! 👋😀

That's our first entry in dev diary 🥳 We've been working hard and are ready to show our updates 💪 Also, we're excited to announce that we're preparing a demo of the game for you, and very soon you'll be able to play it. And now, onto the news!

❄New Level

We've created a winter location! It's not at all cold, but rather cozy and warm. While making it, we were inspired by the past Christmas holidays and wanted to extend that joyful moment a little 🎁🎄 The winter level is a small room that our heroine shares with her brother. We plan to make it the very first level in the game and start our heroine's story from there

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44817681/cfd750e4135b86b9e02ada71efc22b60ebfec5e8.gif


📘Diary

Additionally, we've created a diary with all the important events in the heroine's life. You'll be able to learn more about her. Also, the diary will keep track of all the new flowers in the collection 🌿

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44817681/32bdca7f0c0aeccdd0e21cfd6f09d859ef6fe140.png

🐈CATTO

We promised - we delivered, now you can pet the cat 🤩! In the future, we plan to add more animations and different "meow" tones to it, but for now, it shows lil hearts and asks why did you wake him up

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44817681/27be4361d5cb4d02ef797a11141f6a1a30b5472b.gif


🎮Demo

The most important news - we're preparing a demo of the game for you. It wasn't easy, but we're almost ready to show it to you. We'll definitely announce the release of the demo and will be happy to hear your feedback 😃

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44817681/e657c3897cb5cf68365a16c74b7a8a638d28148a.png

🎼Music/h1]

Thanks to our friend Semyon Semyonov, cozy music appeared in the game, allowing you to immerse yourself in the atmosphere of relaxation and comfort 🎤🙌

We've done many other things, but they are boring technical details 😅, so for now, that's all folks. Thanks for your attention.

Until the next update 👋
Maria, Kuinnei & Kirill 🌿💚
